title: The account menu's AI accounts row shows the vendor marks and "Not connected" on the FIRST opening of the menu
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/ui/tracy-model-plan/test/ai-accounts-row-first-open.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the four tests named below.
expect: Starting the plugin (`apply`) asks GET /api/seat-plan/status once, before any menu opens.
A row mounted before the answer shows "AI accounts" alone, then the marks and "Not connected" when the answer lands, without being mounted again.
A row mounted after the answer shows the marks at once.
Two copies of the client bundle on one page make one read and share one status: a Connect published by one shows on the row of the other.
evidence: Measured on dev 09/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/account-menu/dev/hc-*.json): the first opening of the menu listed the AI accounts row as "AI accounts" alone; later openings showed the marks. The status read started only when the row mounted, i.e. when the menu opened.
fence: The read starts when the plugin applies; the status lives once per document under Symbol.for('tracy.model-plan.account-status')

tests: the status is asked for when the plugin starts, before any menu opens
a row mounted before the answer shows the name alone, then the marks when it lands
a row mounted after the answer landed shows it at once
two copies of the client on one page share one read and one copy of the status
